security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: asset: http://asset.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Flights, food, and catering on one trip plan
bundle.longDescription: Bookcation puts flights, hotels, restaurant reservations, and catering on one editable trip plan. Fork plans, compare versions, and book in one checkout. This build is a demo with sample data.
